channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Anderson Varejao | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Anderson Varejao from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Leandro Barbosa on Anderson Varejao
item.description:
Ethan Strauss:Leandro Barbosa on Anderson Varejao:

“We gone' be speaking Portuguese on the court, so no one will know what we talking about. So I can talk A LOT of things”

Leandro Barbosa on Anderson Varejao, Feb 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @SherwoodStrauss.

item.title: Matthew Dellavedova on Anderson Varejao, Sergey Karasev
item.description:
Matthew Dellavedova:

“In my second column,I talked about how Andy Varejao (pictured) took Sergey Karasev and I to a Brazilian restaurant. The other people were joking that we would get sick of it because he likes to go there so much. We thought they were joking about that. I think we have eaten there about three or four more times since then,but Sergey and I still aren’t sick of it, it’s great.”

Matthew Dellavedova on Anderson Varejao, Sergey Karasev, Dec 12, 2013. Source: Bendigo Advertiser.

item.title: Chris Grant on Anderson Varejao
item.description:
Quote from Cavaliers General ManagerChris Grant:

“Clearly our players' health is our top concern and we are disappointed for Anderson, and his family. We know what a competitor he is and how much he wants to be on the court helping his teammates. In the meantime, he has our full support and we look forward to welcoming him back as he recovers.”

Chris Grant on Anderson Varejao, Jan 21, 2013. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Byron Scott on Anderson Varejao
item.description:
Sam Amico:Cavs coach Byron Scott on Anderson Varejao:

“He's the best center in the NBA right now. By far the best in the Eastern Conference.”

Byron Scott on Anderson Varejao, Nov 27, 2012. Source: Twitter @SamAmicoFSO.
